title: Unbounded background task submission
summary: Flask endpoints enqueue background work without idempotency, rate limits, or queue bounds.
rationale: Unbounded task creation can amplify retries, resource consumption, and downstream congestion.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Add idempotency keys, queue limits, backpressure, and duplicate suppression.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
